explanations.text: Residues 1-12 of chain A (12 residues) come from an experimental structure. No model-confidence scores apply to experimental coordinates: the B-factor column of this file holds experimental B-factors, which are a different quantity from pLDDT, so neither pLDDT nor PAE is reported for it. Model confidence is not evidence of folding, binding, affinity, efficacy, safety, or experimental validation.
